items.p: A flat can be in a building the city has earmarked: one day it could expropriate part of it. We read the city council's official affectation verdict and explain what it means for you.
A heritage listing (BCIN / BCIL) limits what you can change: façade, layout, sometimes the windows. We flag it before it derails your renovation budget.
Asking prices run above what flats actually sell for. We show the neighbourhood's recent closing-price range so you can see the gap, and use it to negotiate.

indep.lead: For people buying a home to live in.
indep.body: Not investors. Not short-lets. We work only for the buyer. We never sell flats and never take money from sellers. That's why we can tell you what's wrong with a flat, not just what looks nice.

ph.body: No made-up valuation, no black-box estimate. We give you the official €/m² references and the recent closing-price range for the neighbourhood, and let you judge for yourself. Honest beats precise-looking.

range.cap: A real range from registered sales, not a single magic figure.

partner.p: Buyer's agents, mortgage brokers, lawyers and conveyancers use PisoWise to give clients clarity they can trust. Co-branded reports, referrals and API access available.

pricing.desc: Free preview. Full report and downloadable PDF for {price}.

items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: Only official, open sources: the Catastro, energy registry (ICAEN), the urban-planning map (Mapa Urbanístic), the national flood-risk system (SNCZI), the Ajuntament de Barcelona and the Generalitat's registered closing prices. No portal scraping. Every figure is verifiable and date-stamped.

We report what the official records say and date-stamp every figure. Where the data is incomplete or a benchmark isn't reliable, we say so plainly rather than fill the gap with a guess. It's an orientation tool: it surfaces what to check, not a certified appraisal.

items.q: Can I use it to negotiate?
items.a: Yes. The price section shows the neighbourhood's recent closing-price range next to the asking price, so you can see the gap and bring registered figures, not opinion, to the table.

items.q: Does it replace an architect or lawyer?
items.a: No. It's an orientation tool that tells you what's worth a closer look and what questions to ask. It doesn't replace a technical survey, a legal review or a formal valuation. It helps you decide which of those are worth paying for.
We only need the flat's address or cadastral reference to build a report. We don't sell your data, and we never take money from sellers, so nothing about the report is steered by anyone but you.
The preview is free. The full report and downloadable PDF are {price}. A one-off payment, no subscription.

For now, yes. We cover Barcelona's neighbourhoods in depth rather than the whole country thinly, and we'll tell you if an address falls outside the area where we can stand behind a neighbourhood benchmark.

footer.disc: An orientation tool, not a substitute for a technical survey, legal review or valuation.
